def eyes(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    sc=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if L[r][c]=='S']
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in sc)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in sc))
    left=[c for c in cs if c<32]; right=[c for c in cs if c>=32]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),(min(left),max(left)),(min(right),max(right)))
def bars(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return (sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[0][c]=='B'), sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[63][c]=='B'))

def eyes(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    sc=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if L[r][c]=='S']
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in sc)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in sc))
    left=[c for c in cs if c<32]; right=[c for c in cs if c>=32]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),(min(left),max(left)),(min(right),max(right)))
def bars(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return (sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[0][c]=='B'), sum(1 for c in range(64) if L[63][c]=='B'))
